name: AWS Certified Security – Specialty (SCS-C03)

fee.note: USD list price. A qualifying unused AWS exam discount could reduce it to $150; not account-verified.

exam.format: 65 questions, 170 minutes, three-year validity. AWS's intended audience has five years in IT security and two securing AWS workloads; no prior certification is required.

scope: Securing AWS workloads: identity and access, data protection, detection, incident response and infrastructure security.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
domains_note: Weights from the AWS Certification Exam Guide (SCS-C03), read 2026-11-03.
